int_name: N BROAD ST & W CHAMPLOST AVE

result.summary: The image depicts a wide multi-lane arterial road with a high-visibility continental crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance across five lanes without a refuge island creates significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross five lanes of traffic in a single stage without a protective refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles in the adjacent commercial lot and near the curb line may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the crosswalk entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The intersection is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway that lacks basic pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks and dedicated signals. While sidewalks are present, the environment is heavily oriented toward high-volume commercial vehicle traffic, creating significant exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalization, but suffers from significant maintenance neglect. The roadway lacks clear lane markings and the crosswalks are heavily faded, which increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts in a wide, asphalt-heavy environment.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk in the foreground is extremely worn and barely visible, reducing driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing zone.

hazards.name: Lack of lane markings
hazards.description: The absence of center lines or lane dividers on a wide road can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway can create tripping hazards or cause vehicles to swerve.
